description: Adds json-render for declarative UI composition from JSON specs. Same spec renders across React, Vue, Svelte, and more.

architectureNotes: json-render lets you define UI as JSON specs that render with real shadcn components.
Use defineCatalog() with shadcnComponentDefinitions to constrain what AI can generate.
Use defineRegistry() with shadcnComponents to wire up the actual React implementations.
Specs support state binding ($state), conditional visibility ($cond), and form validation.
Same spec can target React, Vue, Svelte, React Native, PDF, email via different renderers.
